items.description: Surge-damaged speaker system and TV set (replacement supply)
items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 as lightning overvoltage on appliances; sub-limit EUR 5,000 aggregate; no surge protector established, so 50% reduction after 7.1.9 standard-grade pricing. Estimated standard TV plus speaker system about EUR 2,400, halved to about 1,200; max 2,500.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
items.rationale: Diagnostic report/documentation and call-out are not repair costs (7.1.8(d),(e)); wiring safety check on undamaged installation falls under 7.1.5; predominant purpose not indemnifiable under 7.1.10. If paid, halved.
